name: 01770 · Sherborn, MA
findings: ZIP 01770 (Sherborn) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01770 (Sherborn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01770 (Sherborn) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
